title: The Scribe: Vyasa, Brahma & Ganesha
location: Vedic forest hermitage beside a clear river, thatched kusa-grass hut, sacred fire altar with rising sandal smoke, ancient banyan roots, deer grazing in soft dawn light. Strictly 1000 BCE Vedic era: palm-leaf bundles and birch bark only, no paper books, no carved stone temples.

acts.name: I. The Poem With No Writer
III. The Tusk, the Knots & the Lamp

shots.camera: Extreme wide, 24mm, slow push-in toward the thatched hut
shots.action: In a quiet forest hermitage at dawn, @vyasa sits still before the sacred fire, holding the entire epic in his mind.
shots.sound: Forest river bed, early dawn birds, faint crackle of the fire altar.
shots.frame: Wide establishing frame of a thatched Vedic hermitage under an ancient banyan tree by a misted river. @vyasa sits centered on a woven mat in quiet stillness beside the fire altar, eyes half-closed, stacks of tied palm-leaf bundles beside him.
motion: 0-6s: slow gentle push-in toward @vyasa; thin incense and altar smoke curls upward; leaves drift in morning light.

shots.action: @vyasa opens his eyes, wondering who on earth can write down the vast poem he has composed.
shots.sound: Low tanpura drone enters gently; quiet breath.
shots.frame: @vyasa in medium close-up lit by warm altar firelight from below and cool dawn blue fill from behind, forehead tripundra marks crisp, hands resting calmly on his knees.
motion: 0-3s: his eyes open slowly.
3-5s: faint furrowing of his brow as he looks toward the empty palm leaves.

shots.camera: Locked symmetrical wide, 35mm, zero camera movement
shots.action: The four-faced @brahma appears in soft golden light above a lotus seat; @vyasa rises with joined palms, bows, and walks around him.
shots.sound: Pure harmonic chord swells softly; footsteps on packed earth.
shots.frame: Strictly symmetrical sacred frame. Center: @brahma suspended upon an open pink-gold lotus radiating warm golden light against blue dawn mist. Foreground left: @vyasa standing with joined palms in reverence.
motion: 0-2s: golden light blooms calmly around the lotus; @brahma materializes in stillness without walking in.
2-5s: @vyasa bows deeply with joined palms.
5-7s: @vyasa circles the lotus seat clockwise and sits nearby.

shots.camera: Medium two-shot dissolving into three 1.5s painted cosmic flashes, then back
shots.action: @vyasa speaks of all his poem contains—stars, oceans, dharma, and war—and says no writer exists on earth.
shots.sound: Vyasa VO (lines 428-446 trimmed); brief distant ocean swell and war drum echo under the montage.
shots.frame: Over @vyasa speaking to @brahma seated on the golden lotus, soft painted vision-layers drift in the firelight: constellations, sacred rivers, and tiny chariot silhouettes on Kurukshetra.
motion: 0-2.5s: @vyasa speaks humbly with joined hands.
2.5-6.5s: rapid painted montage of stars, rivers, and distant armies in warm gold dust.
6.5-8s: back to @brahma listening calmly.

shots.action: @brahma names Vyasa's work a true poem and counsels him: 'Think of Ganesa to write it,' then vanishes in light.
shots.sound: Brahma VO: 'Let Ganesa be thought of, O Muni, for the purpose of writing the poem.' Single soft bell.
shots.frame: Locked centered frame of four-faced @brahma glowing gently on his lotus seat, one palm raised in blessing.
motion: 0-3s: @brahma speaks without sudden gesture.
3-5s: golden radiance dissolves cleanly back into dawn mist, leaving the space empty.

shots.camera: Locked symmetrical wide, 35mm, balanced left-right framing
shots.action: @vyasa closes his eyes and calls @ganesha in thought; @ganesha appears before him and sits ready to write.
shots.sound: Deep warm conch-like resonance, subtle chime as @ganesha manifests.
shots.frame: Locked symmetrical frame across the hermitage mat: LEFT @vyasa seated calmly; RIGHT @ganesha seated with palm-leaf sheets arranged cleanly before him, sacred fire glowing at center.
motion: 0-2s: @vyasa closes his eyes in concentration.
2-4s: warm vermilion-gold radiance coalesces on the right into @ganesha.
4-6s: @ganesha bows slightly and takes his seat.

shots.action: @ganesha states his condition that his pen never stop; @vyasa answers that he must not write what he has not understood. @ganesha says 'Om'.
shots.sound: Ganesha VO & Vyasa VO (lines 471-475); low resonant 'Om' vibrates softly.
shots.frame: @ganesha holding his stylus poised above fresh palm leaf, eyes steady on @vyasa across the fire.
motion: 0-3s: @ganesha raises his stylus hand slightly as he speaks his condition.
3-5s: cut to @vyasa answering calmly.
5-6s: @ganesha lowers the stylus onto the palm leaf with 'Om'.

shots.camera: Macro insert on palm leaf and stylus, 100mm, tracking along the line
shots.action: The stylus glides rapidly across incised palm-leaf strips, etching Sanskrit lines without pause as leaves stack up.
shots.sound: Rhythmic crisp scratch of stylus on dry palm leaf, steady heartbeat pace.
shots.frame: Close macro of @ganesha's hand driving a bronze stylus across pale-green/tan palm leaves, crisp incised grooves catching warm firelight.
motion: 0-4s: rapid, fluid strokes across the leaf; finished leaf slides cleanly aside.
4-5s: sudden snap—the bronze stylus tip fractures on the dense knot of grain.

shots.camera: Locked symmetrical medium frame, 50mm, 2-frame white-gold impact flash on the snap
shots.action: His pen failing mid-verse, @ganesha immediately snaps off his right tusk and writes on without missing a beat.
shots.sound: Sharp ivory crack, brief 2D flash hush, then immediate steady stylus scratching resuming.
shots.frame: Locked centered frame of @ganesha: left hand steadies the palm leaves, right hand snaps the tip of his right ivory tusk and brings it straight down onto the leaf without breaking rhythm.
motion: 0-2s: anticipation as his hand grips the tusk tip.
2-2.2s: 2-frame graphic white-gold impact frame on the snap (2D FX).
2.2-6s: fluid continuous writing with the tusk on the palm leaf.

shots.camera: Medium wide two-shot, 50mm, gentle slow push-in
shots.action: @vyasa knits a dense verse; even the omniscient @ganesha pauses briefly to ponder it while @vyasa composes ahead with a quiet smile.
shots.sound: Stylus scratching stops abruptly; warm silence, quiet smile-breath from Vyasa, then writing resumes.
shots.frame: @vyasa on the left composing effortlessly with a faint warm smile; @ganesha on the right holding his tusk-stylus poised just above the leaf, brows lifted in deep thought.
motion: 0-2s: tusk stops mid-air over the leaf.
2-4.5s: @ganesha tilts his head, pondering the knot; @vyasa smiles faintly.
4.5-6s: @ganesha nods in comprehension and resumes writing swiftly.

shots.camera: Crane up from the palm-leaf firelight into warm golden radiance
shots.action: Over the first verses of the Bharata, the light of the sacred fire swells like a lamp dispelling darkness across the earth.
shots.sound: Warm tanpura drone swells into a luminous harmonic chord; fire crackle.
shots.frame: From the incised palm-leaf verses glowing amber, a warm golden lamp-light expands outward into soft painted waves pushing back indigo night mist.
motion: 0-6s: crane slowly up as golden 2D light-wash radiates across the dark forest sky.

shots.camera: Locked off, hold to final frame
shots.action: The golden lamp flame settles at center as the darkness clears; the title card 'THE SCRIBE' fades in over the glow.
shots.sound: One deep distant temple-conch resonance, drone fades gently to stillness.
shots.frame: Minimalist locked frame: a single warm oil-lamp flame burning steadily in painted gold against deep umber, holding calm stillness.
motion: 0-3s: flame steadies; warm golden light holds.
3-6s: hold calm flame (title added in edit, never baked in frame).
